text:
maria: Heads-up — nightly eval flagged a big regression on the QA promptset for redwood-v2-3b-8q8 after last night's quantization rollout. Error rate up ~14% vs baseline. eval-bot: nightly-evals detected regression: model=redwood-v2-3b-8q8, promptset=qa_longform, metric=exact_match, delta=-0.14.

chen: Oof. Any quick suspects? quantization alone shouldn't change determinism. Did runtime change seeds or sampling defaults?

maria: I ran a quick diff of the inference config between canary and prod. Canary had `temperature: 0.8, top_p: 0.95, top_k: 50`. Prod uses `temperature: 0.7, top_p: 0.95, top_k: 40`. But the canary binary accidentally shipped a default `top_p: 0.9` override in the server config.

alex: That's interesting — lower top_p should make outputs less diverse, not more hallucination-y. Could be interaction with top_k or the seed handling. Did the eval harness use deterministic seeds?

sam: I checked the harness: we set `seed=42` in the sampling wrapper, but when streaming is enabled we fall back to non-deterministic path in the runtime which ignores seed. I suspect the rollout toggled streaming on by default.

chen: Can you paste the minimal repro command? I'll try to reproduce locally with the exact runtime flags.

maria: Sure. Repro command we used: 
```bash
# nightly eval command
python run_eval.py --model redwood-v2-3b-8q8 --promptset qa_longform --runs 3 --seed 42 --temperature 0.8 --top_p 0.95 --top_k 50 --streaming false
```
When run against canary VM we get baseline em=0.72. Against prod VM (with streaming default true and top_p override 0.9) em=0.58.

chen: Reproduced locally after toggling streaming to true + top_p=0.9. With streaming=false + seed=42 I get consistent answers. With streaming=true seed is ignored and variability explodes.

alex: So two distinct issues: (1) unintended top_p override in canary/prod config, (2) streaming path ignores seed (determinism bug). Both can cause drift. Which one explains the 14% drop?

sam: I ran ablation: keep streaming=true but restore top_p=0.95 -> EM drops ~6% from baseline. Keep top_p=0.9 but streaming=false -> EM drops ~8%. Both together give ~14% which matches observed regression.

maria: Nice. Sounds like we need a hotfix: revert streaming default to false in the prod rollout and patch the runtime to respect seed in streaming mode. Also fix the config override for top_p.

chen: Agreed. I'll open a runtime bug: "streaming path ignores sampler seed" and assign to eng-runtime. I'll paste a failing unit test snippet.
```python
def test_streaming_respects_seed():
    model = load_model('redwood-v2-3b-8q8')
    out1 = model.sample(prompt, seed=123, streaming=True)
    out2 = model.sample(prompt, seed=123, streaming=True)
    assert out1 == out2, 'streaming path should be deterministic with seed'
```

alex: I'll handle the rollout revert and config fix in the deployment repo. Pushing a rollback to the canary/prod flags now. ETA 30m. @sam can you run a quick nightly-eval rerun against prod once rollback is live?

sam: On it. Will run the eval harness (fast-mode) after rollback and post results.

eval-bot: nightly-evals started rerun: run_id=20260215-176234, targets=[redwood-v2-3b-8q8], promptset=qa_longform.

maria: Also: let's add a policy that any default changes to sampling params (temperature/top_p/top_k/streaming) must be gated behind the eval harness and reviewed by eng-ml. Too easy to accidentally change user-visible defaults.

chen: +1. I'll add a checklist item to the model onboarding docs and create a preflight script to diff effective sampling params between builds.

alex: Update: rollback applied to prod flags, streaming default=false restored, top_p override removed.

sam: Rerun results: EM=0.71 (baseline 0.72) — regression largely gone. Remaining delta within noise.

maria: Excellent. Action items: (1) chen -> runtime bug + unit test (PR open by EOD). (2) alex -> add sampling-defaults gate to release process (PR). (3) sam -> add nightly-eval alert to include a short config snapshot in the report (so we can see sampling defaults). (4) eng-ml -> add a small explainer doc on streaming vs non-streaming determinism.

chen: I'll also add a telemetry metric: when streaming=true and seed provided, emit a warning log and a metric so we can catch similar mismatches.

maria: Thanks all :raised_hands: — putting follow-ups in Linear and tagging eng-runtime + eng-platform. Closing thread once PRs are up.

alex: Great triage. Learned a lot about how sampling defaults + streaming interact.

sam: Leaving logs and diffs in the incident gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/streaming-seed-drift-176234 (contains sample outputs, config diffs, and eval run ids).

eval-bot: nightly-evals completed: run_id=20260215-176234, status=success, em=0.71

maria: resolved for now, will reopen if nightly shows reappearance."
